نسترأف (form X)
# نُسْتَرْأَفُ (nustarʔafu) /nus.tar.ʔa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# نُسْتَرْأَفَ (nustarʔafa) /nus.tar.ʔa.fa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# نُسْتَرْأَفْ (nustarʔaf) /nus.tar.ʔaf/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
